rationale: Despite an 8.86% opening gap and 4.15x relative volume, price action in the first five minutes has been highly erratic, sweeping from $56.81 down to $54.62 and back to $56.08. Price is currently trapped in the middle of its wide initial range (66.7%), sitting above session VWAP ($55.64) but below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($56.75), offering poor risk-to-reward in either direction especially when factoring in the wide 28.5 bps bid-ask spread.
